metaDescription: Order custom box sports gear in bulk. Perfect for corporate events, team giveaways, and promotional campaigns. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Box sports gear bundles multiple high-quality items into a single, branded package ideal for corporate outings, safety incentive programs, and team-building events. Unlike single-item giveaways, these curated sets—like a cooler, chair, and blanket combo—offer greater perceived value and versatility. Choose from pre-assembled kits or mix and match items such as the KOOZIE® Kamp Chair and Coleman® Camp Wagon to create a custom assortment that fits your budget and audience. Decoration options include screen printing or embroidery on select pieces.
heroAltText: Custom box sports gear bundle including a branded cooler, chair, and blanket for outdoor corporate events
